bogsten_granny_10.m: Bogsten, my dear great-grandchild! After all these years you come to visit me again!
r: Sorry, I am not of your family. I am $playername from Crossglen.

bogsten_granny_20.m: Really? My eyes don't seem to be as clear as they used to be.

bogsten_granny_30.m: Where is this naughty boy? He should have come for cleaning every week.
r: I met him in the house upstairs. He was very ill.

bogsten_granny_32.m: Death is not a reason to neglect one's duties!

bogsten_granny_34.m: Ill? You mean lazy and sleepy!

bogsten_granny_40.m: I never could stand that spoiled kid. He only ever comes to get new gold from the family treasure.

bogsten_granny_42.m: Ungrateful indeed. I would rather give our gold to some random beggar than to see it squandered by him.

bogsten_granny_50.m: Tell me child, where are you going in the world?
r: My father sent me to find my brother Andor. He left some time ago and hasn't come back yet.

bogsten_granny_52.m: It really is an honorable goal. I like you, my child. Truly.
r: Did you see my brother? He looks a bit like me.

bogsten_granny_54.m: No, I haven't seen Andor. I hope that you will find him soon and that you can return to your father together.
r: My father will be very glad.

bogsten_granny_60.m: How touching! I will give you something. You really deserve a little gold.

bogsten_granny_80.m: Go ye into our family tomb. You may pick something from our treasures.

bogsten_granny_90.m: It was a pleasure to meet you. Farewell, kid!

bogsten_granny_92.m: Ah, so you found your way downstairs. Smart child, it was a pleasure to meet you. Farewell!

bogsten_granny_94.m: So you've chosen my gardening gloves. A wise choice!

bogsten_granny_96.m: There used to be also a family-owned cookbook. Unfortunately that has been lost. It contained valuable recipes - the mushroom soup in particular was a dream!

fungi_panic_nondisplayed.200: Bogsten's grand grand grandmother invited me to their family tomb.
fungi_panic_nondisplayed.210: You found a hidden way downstairs.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
